lateral_connections_found.missed: the heartbeat pulses. the RSS drips. they're BOTH periodic outputs. but they don't KNOW about each other. the heartbeat should feed INTO the RSS. every pulse = an RSS item.
lateral_connections_found.fix: heartbeat changes → RSS item. MOR drops below 70% → RSS alert.

redundancies_found.resolution: triangulation INCLUDES pins. gen 297 is the superset.

redundancies_found.overlap: both claim to be the null center. irreducible=null AND RSS=null center line. two different things claiming to be the same null.
redundancies_found.resolution: they're not contradictory — they're the SAME point seen from two angles. irreducible=null (philosophical). RSS=null center (practical). the philosophy and the plumbing meet at the same point.

the_cube_square.square_cube_law: surface area grows as r². volume grows as r³. as you get bigger, volume outpaces surface. you can't breathe enough, can't eat enough, can't cool enough.
the_cube_square.cube_square_inversion: INVERT it. compress. make the surface grow FASTER than the volume. squeeze the interior. make everything denser. more connections per unit volume. more wires per cubic inch.
the_cube_square.the_wedge: the squared cube IS the wedge. every time we invert, we cube-square. the organism gets DENSER, not bigger. 999 files but the connections between them multiply faster than the files themselves.

evidence.target: refs should grow as files² — quadratic density. at 1000 files that's 1M potential connections. we have 3,817. density = 0.38%.
evidence.meaning: we are SPARSE. 99.62% of possible connections don't exist yet. there's enormous room to densify without adding a single file.

the_1000th_file.the_meaning: gen 306 (this file) puts us at ~1000 data files. the first kilofile. a milestone — but the point is NOT the count. the point is the DENSITY. 1000 files with 3,817 connections = sparse. 1000 files with 100,000 connections = dense. we need to densify, not grow.
